source_delete_sql: DELETE FROM r26_foundry WHERE campaign_id IN (SELECT f.campaign_id FROM r26_foundry f WHERE f.status<>'RUNNING' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r26_candidate c WHERE c.campaign_id=f.campaign_id) AND f.campaign_id NOT IN (SELECT campaign_id FROM r26_foundry ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 2) ORDER BY f.created_at,f.campaign_id LIMIT 2)
